question: Who transmitted the teaching concerning the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs?
premises: The subject concerns the earth-moving yoginīs
They are described as good eaters
inference: An earth-moving yoginī transmitted the teaching concerning the auspicious earth-movers.
uncertainties: Instrumental sense of bhūcarī is inferred from context
plain_english: O beloved, it was told concerning the auspicious earth-moving yoginīs by an earth-mover.
